answer: Every attester publishes a comet tail: a rolling Merkle chain of the last 64 attestations, signed and posted publicly. A clone cannot extend the original's tail without the key, so a forked tail is the sybil fingerprint. When two addresses share a tail ancestor but diverge, both freeze and both bonds burn. A nectar reward pays the first honest reporter of a fork, and a lotus cap holds each address to one live tail per epoch, so a farm cannot hide forks behind rotation. Attacker cost: 100 clones means 200 burned bonds plus the loss of every tail's standing.
